title: Transportability from San Francisco: different click-through rate
content: Figure 10.2(d) retains the target causal graph and adds selector S -> Click-through Rate W because San Francisco has a higher click-through rate.

variables.name: Purchase Decision (Y)
variables.content: Whether the consumer purchases the product.

variables.name: Age (Z)
variables.content: Age, a confounder of advertisement and purchase.

variables.name: Click-through Rate (W)
variables.content: The mediator whose population mechanism differs.

variables.name: Population Difference (S)
variables.content: The difference-producing selector for San Francisco click-through rate.

arrows.because: Figure 10.2(d) points selector S to Click-through Rate W.
